en: A colorized panoramic view of a small European town set in a hilly landscape. In the foreground, fields stretch toward a steam locomotive pulling passenger cars along a railway line. Behind the tracks lies the town with red‑roofed houses, larger villas, a few factory chimneys, and a prominent church with a tall spire to the right. The sky is lightly clouded. At the top center, in red lettering, is the caption identifying the place.
